headline: One banknote.
One very quiet city.
about.support: Base City went quiet. Cashy, the Base Note, moves in to rebuild it block by block, connecting people and stocks on Base. 0.85% of every trade goes to holders, paid in MSTR stock, about daily.

skyline.label: A neon city skyline at night under a blue moon. Cashy, a banknote in sunglasses and a leather jacket, stands on a rooftop ledge with his arms crossed.

hype.title: Base City is waking up
hype.lede: Cashy moved in to switch the lights back on. Every trade on Feel.cash keeps the city running, and the fees are shared with holders in MSTR stock.

points.title: Every trade prints
points.text: 0.85% of every Cashy trade goes to holders, paid in MSTR stock.

points.title: Payday is MSTR day
points.text: Payouts go out about daily. Hold at least 100,000 CASHY to qualify.

points.title: Built on Base
points.text: Launched on Feel.cash and paired with MSTRc. Where people meet stocks, on Base.
